Seoul — Gangnam.plastic: Rinse the plastic container, remove the label and cap. Dispose in transparent bags.
Seoul — Gangnam.paper: Fold paper and cardboard, tie with string. Remove any tape from boxes.
Seoul — Gangnam.glass: Clear of any contents. Remove metal or plastic caps.
Seoul — Gangnam.metal: Flatten cans or tins. Dispose in metal collection bins.
Seoul — Gangnam.organic: Drain excess moisture. Dispose strictly in special yellow Food Waste Bags.
Seoul — Gangnam.general: General trash must be disposed strictly in special white General Trash Bags (종량제봉투).

Seoul — Mapo.plastic: Remove films and stickers. Clean plastic items should be placed in transparent bags.
Seoul — Mapo.paper: Dry paper and cardboard. Dispose of wet or dirty paper in general waste.
Seoul — Mapo.glass: Glass containers without cracks should be submitted separately. Wrap broken glass in thick paper and place in general waste.
Seoul — Mapo.metal: Crush metal beverage and food cans before disposal.
Seoul — Mapo.organic: Use designated Mapo district food waste bags.
Seoul — Mapo.general: Use standard Mapo district general waste bags.
